subject: Three way interaction: space time with continuous covariate

messages.author: d54aba6af40f8c5e
messages.subject: Three way interaction: space time with continuous covariate
parts:
Hello,

I am looking at your excellent paper "A unified view on Bayesian varying coefficient models" and am looking to expand the PM example defined by formulas 15-18. In this model, the effect of PM varies by space.

I was wondering if you had any pointers/examples where one could expand this model so the effect of PM varies by both space and time.

Thanks in advance,

John
